---
name: task-routing
description: Identify the user's intended outcome and choose a suitable SDLC workflow.
---

Pick a Playbook from the goal, code context and authorization; prefer the explicit user task over keyword routing. Prepare the Task Contract without burdening the user with routine implementation questions. Inspect actual evidence when requirements are vague. Escalate only genuine banking product decisions, restricted actions or irreversible changes.

Verification may create/edit test-scoped code when authorized by the task; it never grants product code edits. Record risk flags and use the model policy. Report a missing real adapter as BLOCKED, not a simulated PASS.
